text:
emily: quick async — quick status: finished spanish tokenization smoke for synthia-v2, found a brittle prompt that drops context for dates. added a temporary prompt fallback and flagged for evals.

raj: thanks — can you paste the prompt change? want to see if it's too hacky.

emily: pasted below:
```
PROMPT: 'You are an assistant. Extract the date from the input. If not explicit, ask follow-up: \"When exactly?\"'
```: I added an explicit fallback trigger when confidence < 0.45.

taylor: fyi, the confidence metric is from the ner-checker eval, right? does the gating use that number or a different score?

emily: ner-checker. Gating currently uses aggregated score from eval-run (ner + calibrator). i set a temporary threshold to 0.45 to unblock smoke.

casey: sounds reasonable. any regressions on en/pt tests?

emily: quick run on en shows no regressions. pt had one weird truncation on long inputs — probably kv-cache alignment with quantized weights. filing ticket: ML-4872.

nora: can you add a short promptset for the eval harness? 10-15 cases that cover ambiguous dates + long-kv contexts. i can slot it into today's scrim.

emily: will push a small promptset to the evals repo in a sec and tag you. also opening a CR for the prompt change — small one-line edit. cc @taylor for review.

raj: pinging for CR review — if you can glance quickly, we can roll the temp fallback and then schedule a nicer fix (prob model-side tokenization tweak).

ops-bot: deploy-check: no dedicated capacity changes. sandbox tests passed (3/3). Canary window scheduled for 12:40 UTC.

casey: ack. if canary passes, let's let fallback run for 24h then revert to model fix.

emily: plan noted. blockers: none immediate beyond getting a quick CR review. today: finish promptset, open eval-run with the new cases, monitor canary.

taylor: i'll review the CR in ~20m. thanks for the clear notes. :thumbsup:

raj: also — quick heads up, QA asked for a sample log snippet to track when fallback triggers. emily, can you add a small telemetry event 'prompt_fallback.v1' with model, prompt_id, and conf_score? nothing PII.

emily: adding telemetry now. will post example event here once shipped.

nora: perfect. thanks team. anyone else with raises/blocks?

casey: none.

emily: closing loop later with results from canary and eval-run.

ops-bot: reminder: daily-scrim at 13:00 UTC.
